new_findings.wrong: m3 'Baseline vorhanden?' -> nein -> m4 'Wird Baseline · spätere Vergleiche lesen sie'.
source: native/profiling.rs:177-179 compare reads the explicit baseline path
assets/operations.json profile.compare (baseline, current, budgets, report)
qml/ProfileWorkspace.qml 'Catch regressions': Compare enabled only when the 'Previous JSON report' field is filled
new_findings.actual: Tomacco never stores or promotes a report as a baseline. A saved report is just a JSON file; a later profile.compare or profile.budget call has to name it. Without a baseline there is no comparison; nothing happens automatically.
new_findings.correction: Replace m3/m4 with 'Früheren Bericht als baseline angegeben?' nein -> 'Bericht bleibt eine Datei; später als baseline angeben' (style dim, not a state).
new_findings.evidence: grep finds no baseline registry or default path in profiling.rs/perf.rs; testing.baselines (D21) is a separate screenshot concept.

new_findings.wrong: a2 'Checkliste ok? (release.checklist)' -> nein -> a7 'Nicht bereit: target_sdk · version_code · debuggable · Debug-Schlüssel' (style err), ja -> a3 build -> a4 sign. This draws the checklist as a gate before build and signing.
source: native/releases.rs:50 release.checklist -> release_checks::checklist (its only caller)
assets/operations.json release.checklist readOnlyHint true; release.sign, play.prepare have no checklist input
qml/ReleaseWorkspace.qml:16-53 calls release.sign/verify/keystore/version, not release.checklist
new_findings.actual: release.checklist is an advisory, read-only report (pass/fail per check). Nothing in release.sign, play.prepare or the Release view reads it, so a failing checklist blocks nothing; a debuggable or debug-signed build can still be signed and prepared.
new_findings.correction: Make a2 a step 'Checkliste lesen (nur Bericht)' with a dashed/dim edge to a note 'fail-Einträge sind Hinweise; release.sign und play.prepare prüfen sie nicht'. Draw a0/a1 -> a3 -> a4 as the actual path, and drop the err style on a7 (or turn it into the report node).
new_findings.evidence: Only grep hit for release_checks:: outside its own file is the dispatcher line.

new_findings.wrong: Lead 'die Entscheidung trifft eine Person', and the only path to p9 'Commit' goes through human nodes p7 'Person prüft den Edit' and p10 'Destruktiv bestätigen'.
source: assets/operations.json play.commit required credentials, package, edit_id; no confirm field; destructiveHint true
native/guard.rs:282-299 approval only for MCP when approval is enabled (default off); no desktop -> allowed unless without_desktop: deny
qml/Workspace.qml:245-256 Tools-form confirmation
new_findings.actual: Publishing is gated by a person only in the Tools form (and over MCP only when the opt-in approval is on and a desktop is open or without_desktop is deny). With defaults, an MCP agent or tomaccoctl call commits immediately with an edit_id; no step checks that a person reviewed the edit. The board's first note says most of this, so the lead and edges contradict the board's own note.
new_findings.correction: Lead: 'die Entscheidung soll eine Person treffen; Tomacco erzwingt sie nur im Werkzeuge-Formular und bei eingeschalteter MCP-Freigabe'. Split p10 by channel: 'Werkzeuge-Formular fragt' / 'MCP: nur mit Freigabe (Standard aus)' / 'CLI: fragt nie – Agent soll die Person fragen (nicht erzwungen)', all leading to p9. Same pattern as R05.
new_findings.evidence: guarded(): `if mcp && destructive && settings.approval_enabled()`; CLI channel never reaches ask().
